notes.title: iZolated Update - August 12, 2025
notes.content: [h3][b]A year has passed since the game's release, and it's time to take stock![/b][/h3][p]This was the first project for LT-Games and the developer Crooked Road, which unfortunately had an unsuccessful launch and instead of Early Access, the project was released in a technical release. However, the developer Crooked Road put in a lot of effort and released 22 patches for the game over the course of this year thanks to your feedback.[/p][p]From a financial model perspective, the project has only recouped 1/9 of its costs, and we honestly acknowledge that we know the main issue - technical problems with GameMaker Studio 1.4, which we initially failed to identify during the game's development stage.[/p][p]As it turned out, the main problems (Out of Memory) were related to the core level of the GameMaker Studio 1.4 game engine due to cache and buffer limitations of only 1 Gb RAM, as well as very poor integration with integrated graphics cards in laptops and personal computers.[/p][p]We also lacked the time and finances to release the final patch 1.0.0 by today, and after discussing the situation with colleagues, despite the project's unprofitability, we decided to continue support, but in a somewhat less active manner, to bring the project to the release patch, and then, once we have sufficient funds, to try to port the game to the GameMaker Studio 2.0 engine to resolve the main issues of the game and possibly finally add a cooperative gameplay mode.[/p][p]As part of the testing on the new game engine GameMaker Studio 2.0, we are launching a demo version of the new project [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3924950/Brew_or_Die_Demo"]Brew or Die[/url] – an RPG game with TBS elements, which will be released on 08/12/2025 at 10:45 AM PDT. We invite everyone to test the new game and provide feedback, as it is crucial for the preparation of [b]iZolated[/b] transition to the new game engine![/p][p][/p][p][b]There is also currently a Isometric RPG Sale 2025 with a 30% discount on the game until August 18, 2025![/b] [/p][p]Our teams would be grateful for the support of future game updates.[/p][p][/p][p][b]PATCH CHANGELOG:[/b][/p][p]- Project optimization work has been carried out.[/p][p]- Errors in Portuguese and English localization have been fixed.[/p][p]- Errors in camp quests have been corrected.[/p][p]- Errors in object interactions have been fixed.[/p][p]- The nightmare "Faceless Hunt" has been refined, and errors have also been found and corrected.[/p][p]- Game balance has been adjusted.[/p][p]- Some elements of the main menu and pause menu have been improved.[/p][p]- The inventory system has been refined.[/p][p]- The crafting system has been improved.[/p][p][/p][p]Please check the relevance of all previously found errors. [/p][p]If you discover any new critical errors, please report them to us on the game's Discord server: [url="https://discord.gg/fRJ26z9Q8b"]https://discord.gg/fRJ26z9Q8b[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Very important news for players!
notes.content:
[b]We apologize![/b]

We recently published a news item and chose the wrong wording. This has upset many people due to misunderstandings.

[b]We hurry to answer your questions right now:[/b]

[b]Is the project closing?[/b]
- We say right away that nobody is going to abandon the project! We will only force the production and focus on the main things: fixing bugs and completing the story part of the game, instead of expanding the content and adding new features. This is done solely in favor of the continued production of the project. Thanks to such hot feedback, we suggest that you create your own posts in the Community and share your expectations from the game, what bugs need to be fixed as soon as possible, and what improvements and additions you want to see in the game. And with this we tell you - Support for the game will continue.

[b]No cooperative mode?[/b]
- Many people are asking for a cooperative mode. But we can't afford it at the moment. It requires hiring additional specialists and buying and paying for equipment for the network component.... You need money for all that. But the game does not bring enough income. That's why it was decided to complete all the basic work as quickly as possible, so that in the future we will have enough opportunities to expand the game based on current resources and capabilities.

[b]There will be no new content?[/b]
- Many people complain about the fact that there is no more content in the game, but all the efforts are spent on polishing mechanics and removing bugs. Yes much of the work may not be noticeable to many players.... But we listen to everyone and put all complaints into a large list of edits. Some tasks, seemingly simple at first glance, can be very time-consuming and can't always be solved at once. But we work with all complaints and prioritize them. 

Your concern about the fate of the project gives us great inspiration to work further and meet your expectations! Even more surprising was the support of some players with the offer of help with translations into French, Spanish, German and Chinese, as well as help with the technical part. We are now confident that we will succeed with you!

- But all the efforts are spent on polishing mechanics and removing bugs.

notes.title: Preparing for the early release of the game
notes.content:
[b]Preparations for the early release of the game have begun![/b].

Earlier we planned that exactly 1 year after the Early Access release the game will go into full release, but we decided to prepare for the early release of the game already on May 12, 2025. 

In preparation for the early release we have prepared for you a 30% discount on the game from February 7, 2025 to February 21, 2025!

Also for those who have previously purchased the game and want to support the development of the game we have released a couple of in-game items that you can see on the game page.

We thank everyone for your trust and support, thanks only to you dear players the project can develop!

[b]Localization of the game into Portuguese (Brazilian) language![/b].

Special thanks to [b]Alan Júnior Morgado Miranda[/b] for translating the game into Portuguese (Brazilian)!

It is only thanks to him that the game has support in Portuguese (Brazilian).
His name is already in the credits of the game for eternity!

We have prepared the possibility to translate the game into other languages, and if you want the game to also be released in your native language, you can help the game developers with the translation. Your feat will be forever recorded in the credits of the game for eternity, and may you be praised for your invaluable help to a small Indie studio!

[b]Game Optimization[/b]

We are doing our best to fix the game's bugs quickly, and thanks to your feedback we have added new settings for the game's graphics and effects. We hope that this will help to solve the most important problem. We are looking forward to your feedback. 

We thank you for timely informing us about bugs and suggestions to improve the game! This allows us to promptly fix and make improvements.

notes.title: iZolated Update - November 07, 2024
notes.content:
[b]Patch 0.3.1 - End of support for the Demo version of the game![/b]

We would like to thank all players for actively looking for game bugs and making suggestions to improve the game.
We have closed the main plot holes at the beginning of the game, and made a sufficient minimum amount of changes, including the game interface, which is no longer subject to changes.

Due to this, support for the Demo version of the game is discontinued and patch 0.3.1 is the last one.
The game content exceeds more than 3 hours of game play.

Also, we have completely separated the Demo from the Main Game to avoid critical bugs that were identified during active play by players, and timely reported to us.

Additionally implemented Cloud saves, which are now linked to your account, and in case you accidentally delete the game or come back after a long time, you will be able to continue from where you last left off.

We are now fully shifting our resources to the Core version of the game in order to polish the game to the possible ideal in time for the 1.0.0 Release so that we can start organizing SteamDeck support, introducing additional game modes, and possibly a multi-player co-op mode.

[b]LIST OF PATCH CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a critical bug when horde appears.
[*] Improved inventory management.
[*] Added drop items after death.
[*] Added pets and their summoning items.
[*] Added the ability to remove weapons from the use slot.
[*] Added a small management guide.
[*] Added VIP storage for saving and carrying special items.
[*] Added a system for activating promo codes.
[*] Improved the news block.
[*] Changed some of the crafts.
[/list]

[b]P.S.:[/b] At the request of players from Brazil we are preparing translation into Portuguese (Brazilian). Upon release of the new localization we may need your help in correcting grammatical and spelling errors!

notes.title: Early Access: Discount in honor of the release!
notes.content:
15% off your game purchase, make sure you buy it now! The promotion will last for 14 days.

[b]- Why Early Access.[/b]
"We desperately need feedback and communication from the community, taking the ideas and feedback from the community we want to improve our game and release a bug-free version."

[b]- How long will the game be in early access?[/b]
"We estimate that the game will be in early access for 8 to 12 months."

[b]- How will the full version differ from the early access version?[/b]
"We plan to add the following:
- Steam achievements;
- New story chapters;
- More quests;
- More recipes for Crafting;
- Improve gamepad support;
- New enemies;
- Community recommendations will be taken into account;
- New locations, weapons, dungeons."

[b]- What will be the status of the Early Access version?[/b]
"Early Access" introduces the first chapter of the game and contains an extensive area with quests, various enemies, as well as the first 16 achievements for Steam and VK Play.
Right now you can play for 8-14 hours. By release, we expect it to be 25-60 hours."

[b]- Will the price of the game be different during and after Early Access?[/b]
"There is a possibility that the price at release will be higher than in Early Access."

[b]- How do you plan to involve the community in the development process?[/b]
"We plan to develop our game interactively with the community on platforms such as Discord and Steam, where you can express your ideas and participate in polls."

Please note that the introduction of Achievements in the game required the need to update the game engine, which led to changes in the syntax of the game code. Critical errors and partial or incorrect operation of Achievements are possible.

[b]Please report any bugs you find in the discussions![/b]

notes.title: Big update of the demo version of the game
notes.content:
[b]We continue to refine the demo version of the game, making a lot of new innovations.[/b]

In this regard, we introduce a three-hour timer on the game, after the end of which further play will not be available until the purchase of the full version of the game. This will allow us to continue introducing innovations until the release of the game.

[b]List of changes in the demo version of the game:[/b]
- Added a new mechanic for disassembling items into materials. You can disassemble anything that in theory can consist of simple resources. Unneeded weapons, clothes, pouches, etc.
- Obtaining new recipes. Some items can be created only after obtaining them or studying the corresponding blueprint. For example, a small and two-handed axe must first be found, and then the crafts for them will be opened.
- Level system - you will get some experience for killing enemies, fishing, hunting, crafting new items, completing quests, etc. With each new level new crafts will be opened, and skill points will be given, which can be distributed where you see fit.
- Search for resources with a metal detector. You can buy this item from a traveling merchant and use it to find various metal objects in the ground. Finding the location of useful loot can be determined by the frequency of crackling of the device. Common loot is ordinary metal, nails, wires, parts and other small things. Occasionally you can find buried iron boxes with hidden interesting things. You can also find fishing hooks and magnets near water bodies, and shell casings and cartridges near military camps.
- Improved the crafting menu, showing the stats of weapons, armor, and other items in the description.
- Added a section with filters to the craft menu, with which you can sort the blueprints by category. This will make it much more convenient to search for the desired craft.
- When fighting infected, with a 2.5% chance instead of calmly getting their asses kicked, they may dodge sideways. Also, this flip of the ears will occur after every fifth missed hit.
- Added enhanced attacks for almost all types of melee weapons. To make a powerful strike, you simply hold down the attack button until enough energy is stored. A charged attack takes 30% of your current stamina, but if it is more than 10% of your maximum stamina.
- The new weapon-tool is a sickle. Its primary task is to cut grass, which can be useful in crafting.
- Finalized the handbook. Changed the font to a more pleasant font, and completely redesigned the game bestiary. As before, a new page opens after killing a mob. Now the guide will display the characteristics of enemies, their immunity to effects, and other information. On the pages appeared lists of items that can fall from a particular mob. Each of these slots can be opened and read more detailed information.
- Added a skill tree with several character pumping branches that can help in your survival.
- The system of day and night. Time runs its course, and day replaces night. But in addition, you can sleep in a tent or sleeping bag to fast-forward time. The loading screen will show exactly the terrain you are in, and also change depending on some objects.
- Increased infected and decreased sanity if you are in total darkness. Your sanity scale will gradually decrease, and when it reaches zero, you will start hallucinating unkillable shadow entities that will kill you for sure. To restore sanity, you can use neuroleptics, or find a light source. You can also upgrade your sanity with special skills.
- Added diversity to the landscape. Hills, mountains, caves.
- Added homemade bombs and grenades, molotov cocktails.
- Updated the job menu, making it more functional and pretty. Also replaced the main interface sounds.
- Added freezing overlay.

[b]Write about any bugs you find in the discussions![/b]
